title: Fields of The World: Field Boundaries for Lithuania
description: Field boundaries and crop area data for Lithuania covering 61,424 agricultural parcels in 2021, sourced from the National Paying Agency under the Ministry of Agriculture. The dataset includes field geometry with crop type and area attributes in EPSG:4326 projection.

_readme.text:
## Description

This is a subset of collection of data on agricultural land and crop areas, cultivated crops in the territory of the Republic of Lithuania.

The original curator of the dataset provided a download service is a set of personalized spatial data of agricultural land and crop areas, cultivated crops. The service provides object geometry with descriptive (attributive) data.

_The field boundaries are valid for the year 2021_

- **Source Data Curator:** [Eurocrops](https://github.com/maja601/EuroCrops/wiki/Lithuania)
- **Original Data Provider:** [The National Paying Agency under the Ministry of Agriculture](https://metadata.vlaanderen.be/srv/dut/catalog.search#/metadata/d869db4a-73f4-470e-b5ca-a0f7cd3ab585)
- **Converted by:** Kerner Lab (ASU)
- **License:** Non-commercial use only
- **Projection:** EPSG:4326

---
